description: Net electricity generation by state and fuel from the EIA (50 states, DC, U.S.; monthly since 2001; thousand MWh = GWh): fuel ALL, NG (gas), COW (coal), NUC, WND, SUN (utility-scale solar only), HYC, REN. For 12-month shares use data product us-electricity-generation. Free (no key or free key): the most recent 30 days of each series; a Pro key unlocks full history. Values are exact as published with unit, date and original source URL; incomplete days are flagged, never filled. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

fuel.description: ALL, NG, COW, NUC, WND, SUN, HYC, REN — comma-separated (default ALL,NG,COW,NUC,WND,SUN)

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ending at the series' latest date. Older dates need a Pro key.

state.description: Two-letter code(s), comma-separated, US for the U.S. total, or all. Default TX,US

name: market_generation
